Hi Samir - great to meet you over email, and glad the quickstart was useful! I'm Marissa on the Solutions team; I usually run the technical demos for platform/infrastructure folks.

Suggested agenda (30 min):
- 5 min intros + goals
- 10 min walkthrough: serving runtime + smart routing and KV/prefix caching
- 10 min focused Q&A: latency at scale, quantization recommendations, private deployment patterns
- 5 min next steps (POC maybe)

I'm available Tue/Wed mornings next week. If either of these slots work, feel free to pick one: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min-tech-demo - or tell me alternatives and I'll send a calendar invite.

I've attached a short tech deck that highlights the topics above. If you want, include your security lead and I'll loop in our security SME.

Thanks,

-
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference - Developer-first inference platform
